full_judgment: 3. Respondent Nos 1 and 2 have entered appearance. In their affidavit-in-opposition it has been stated that transfer of an Industrial License was unlawful under import police order notified under Public Notice No. 1(112)/- 72 date 1.8.72 for the shipping period for which the license was issued and, as the petitioner attempted to transfer his Import license dated 21.10.72 by a forward Sale, the goods imported under the license were seized for violation of section 16 of the Customs Act 1960 read with section 3(1) of Import and Export Control Act, 1950.
